sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Annotation search results: hovering a cover art image (in the big-picture strip or the small one in the Name column) now shows a full card instead of only the name. It shows the Type, the name, its disambiguation comment and primary alias, and, below a line, the whole annotation with its paragraphs, line breaks and formatting. The annotation is always shown in full, even when its cell is collapsed or a section inside it is folded. The card is wider for annotations, and a very long annotation is cut to fit the window, ending in “… (more in the cell)”.
